name: fidelius
description: The fidelius agent skill as a Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: fidelius
plugins.description: Teaches Claude Code to run commands through accio, so a project's API keys come from the fidelius Mac app, built on iCloud Keychain, instead of a .env file. The app is free for one project. Also adds /fidelius:audit, which finds keys saved in Claude Code settings files and MCP server configs, and works without the app.
